artifact-name.description: Upload the output under this artifact name (blank = no upload)

commit-branch.description: Push the output to this orphan branch (blank = no push)

git-history.description: Commits to scan for CO_CHANGE edges (0 = skip)

out.description: Output directory for the graph artifacts

path.description: Local path to index when `repo` is blank

query.description: Question to pack a cited GraphRAG context for (blank = skip). No LLM call is ever made.

query-budget.description: Character budget for the whole pack (map and cite headers included)

query-min-conf.description: Drop CALLS edges below this confidence (0.0-1.0)

query-out.description: File to write the pack to (blank = <out>/agent/pack.md or pack.json)

ref.description: Branch or tag to index when cloning a remote repo

repo.description: Target repo (owner/repo or URL). Leave blank to index `path` in the workspace.

token.description: Token used to clone a private target repo

version.description: pip spec to install repo2graph from (blank = install the action checkout itself)
